title: A new work order for a split customer starts with Labor and Parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Split Fleet.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Create a new work order for {Customer-A}.
  2. Click the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 2: one "Sales Representative" field shows, reading {Sales-rep-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R25: “A new work order for a split customer starts with the Labor and Parts fields: "Sales Representative - Labor" holds the customer's Service Labor person and "Sales Representative - Parts" holds the customer's Service Parts person. Removing its Parts field works as S2-R16.”
  • S2-R16: “Clicking the remove x replaces the two fields with the one "Sales Representative" field. It holds the person who was in "Sales Representative - Labor", or "Unassigned", and that person is credited with the whole work order, labor and parts.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
